PLAN "12-Week Knee-Safe Strength Return to Skiing"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength after right medial meniscus repair"
  GOAL secondary strength:
    name "Prepare legs for return to skiing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body A":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Lower Body B":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          back_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
